title: Zero Copy Federation vs Reverse ETL for Real-Time Segmentation

steps.prompt: Marketing needs Snowflake behavioral scores in Salesforce for near-real-time segmentation. The lake holds 50TB of raw clickstream; leadership rejects duplicating it into Salesforce storage or paying continuous API ingest fees. Which architecture best satisfies freshness, cost, and Trust?

options.label: Scheduled reverse ETL copying 50TB into Custom Big Objects nightly
options.rationale: Physically replicating 50TB creates storage bloat, stale caches between sync windows, and ongoing ingest cost — the antipattern Data 360 Zero Copy is designed to eliminate.

options.label: Data 360 inbound Zero Copy federation to Snowflake, exposing governed shares as Data Lake / Data Model Objects without moving the lake
options.rationale: Inbound Zero Copy federation lets Data 360 query Snowflake in place via governed shares, preserving freshness and avoiding lake duplication while still powering segments and insights.

options.label: Synchronous External Services REST callout on every record page view to fetch scores live
options.rationale: Per-view synchronous callouts degrade UI latency and burn callout rate limits; they do not provide a governed, queryable customer data layer for segmentation at scale.
